name: Comparative Literature Minor
intro: Students can minor in one of two tracks: the literature/media/critical thought track or the foreign language track.

notes: At least three additional COLT courses in one of the three concentrations.
At least one additional COLT course in any of the three concentrations.
At least three additional COLT courses, of which no more than one may be at the 100 or 200 level.
At least one upper-division course in the literature or culture of a foreign language (other than English), with all readings in that language.
